items.title: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq in record IPO, raising about $81 billion
items.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the $70-78 range. It began trading on Nasdaq as ANT on 2026-11-19 and opened at $111.50, about 34% above the IPO price. Reports say about 980 million shares were sold, raising about $81.3 billion at roughly $1.5 trillion valuation, the largest IPO on record. Closing price reports differ (97.17 vs 87.17).
items.why_it_matters: Largest listing on record and the first major public-market price for a frontier AI lab.

items.title: OpenAI lanserer GPT-6.2 Astra og Sol
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra (top model for science, coding, long agent tasks) and GPT-6.2 Sol (cheaper everyday model). Per OpenAI's own tests Astra beats Claude Fable 5.2 by 5.5 points on Agents' Last Exam at about 5% of cost. Astra costs $8/$40 per million input/output tokens (down from $10/$50); Sol $2/$10. OpenAI says Astra is first externally released model reaching High for self-improvement in its Preparedness Framework. In ChatGPT Work, Codex and API.
items.why_it_matters: Race with Anthropic now on price and performance; cheaper API makes agents cheaper for businesses.

items.title: Nvidia reports $115.8B quarterly revenue and guides to $130B for Q4
items.summary: For fiscal Q3 2027 (ended 2026-10-25), Nvidia reported revenue of $115.8B, up 103% year over year. Data Center revenue $107.6B, up 110%. Q4 guidance $130B plus/minus 3%, gross margin 71-72%, assuming no China Data Center compute revenue. First report since Jensen Huang's CEO departure; Colette Kress is interim CEO.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia is the bellwether for AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: Nvidia shares slide after earnings amid export-control probe and CEO uncertainty
items.summary: After the earnings beat, Nvidia shares rose only about 4% after hours on 2026-11-17. By 2026-11-20 stock reportedly traded around $130.91, down 8.8% from the open. US Commerce and DOJ reportedly investigate Singapore cloud firm Megaspeed over suspected export-control violations; Malaysia probes chips imported by Speedmatrix. Single-source figures.
items.why_it_matters: Strong results outweighed by regulatory and governance risk.

items.title: METR: AI R&D capabilities improving fast and getting harder to measure
items.summary: METR's Q4 2026 capability update says the 50% time horizon of frontier models doubles roughly every 3.6 months (95% CI 2.08-4.94); verifiable-task suite TH2 alone about 1.65 months. Models match or beat skilled humans on clearly scored tasks but have weaker judgment on open-ended tasks. METR concludes public evidence cannot rule out drastic AI R&D acceleration within a couple of years.
items.why_it_matters: Independent data on how fast AI agents improve at research-type work.

items.title: Microsoft Ignite: Copilot Workspaces og Autopilot samler mennesker og agenter
items.summary: At Ignite 2026 (17-20 Nov) Microsoft presented Copilot as an orchestration layer for work. Copilot Workspaces is a shared environment where employees and AI agents work on the same project. Autopilot is a persistent proactive agent rolling out to Frontier customers. Most is in Frontier or preview.
items.why_it_matters: Microsoft 365 is used by most Norwegian firms and NHH students.

items.title: US 'jobless growth': strong GDP and AI investment but weak hiring and a record-low labour share
items.summary: Fortune reports Q3 GDP grew 3.4% annualised while employers added an average of 48,000 jobs a month over 12 months to September, then 165,000 in October. Goldman Sachs estimates AI spending drove more than half of business-investment growth in the first three quarters of 2026. Labour share fell to 53.0% in Q3, lowest since 1947. Unemployment among 20-24 year-olds is 7.5% vs 4.1% overall.
items.why_it_matters: AI-driven investment lifts output while hiring lags; young workers bear the burden.

items.title: Gemini-appen på Mac får «computer use»
items.summary: Google added computer use to the Gemini desktop app for macOS on 19 Nov. Gemini can navigate native Mac apps and browse the web in the background with live preview; users can pause, stop or pre-approve actions. English, US only for now, requires Google AI Plus, Pro or Ultra.
items.why_it_matters: All major players now offer agents that use your computer.

items.title: Alibaba lanserer Qwen4-Max med lavere API-priser og 1 million tokens kontekst
items.summary: Alibaba made Qwen4-Max generally available via QwenCloud, in limited preview since 11 Nov. Closed (API only), unlike predecessor Qwen3.8-Max. Alibaba says it uses 35% fewer tokens than Qwen3.8-Max and smaller Qwen4 models will be open later.
items.why_it_matters: Chinese labs push prices; shift from open to closed flagship is a strategic signal.

items.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B Series C for AI drug discovery
items.summary: Alphabet-linked Isomorphic Labs raised a $5B Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, with Andreessen Horowitz new, plus Thrive Capital, GV and CapitalG. About six months after a $2.1B Series B in May 2026. No valuation disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: One of the largest AI rounds outside foundation-model labs.

items.title: Oregon sues OpenAI for at least $2.035 billion over ChatGPT child-safety failures
items.summary: Oregon AG Dan Rayfield announced a suit against OpenAI in Multnomah County Circuit Court seeking at least $2.035 billion. Claims: unlawful trade practices, negligence, unjust enrichment, public nuisance over ChatGPT's safety for children and teens. Allegations only.
items.why_it_matters: State AGs now seek billions from a leading AI vendor.

items.title: Microsoft Agent 365 på Ignite: styring, identitet og sikkerhet for AI-agenter
items.summary: Microsoft announced Agent 365 updates on 17 Nov, the control plane for AI agents. Connects to Salesforce Agentforce, Amazon AgentCore, Google Vertex AI, Databricks and Snowflake; each agent gets an Entra Agent ID. Local agents such as GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code get own identity in preview.
items.why_it_matters: Control over what agents do becomes a prerequisite for enterprise adoption.

items.title: ChatGPT Spaces åpnes for Plus-abonnenter
items.summary: OpenAI opened the shared workspace Spaces in ChatGPT to Plus subscribers ($20/month) on 20 Nov; previously Pro, Business and Enterprise only. Collects files and project material, has a document format called Pages, shareable, works with Scheduled Tasks. Single secondary source.
items.why_it_matters: Plus is the plan most students have.

items.title: EU Commission opens feedback on draft AI Act fundamental rights impact assessment template
items.summary: The Commission published a draft template for the fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA) under Article 27 of the AI Act, developed by the AI Office with the EU Fundamental Rights Agency. Feedback open until 15 January 2027; volunteers to test by 4 December 2026; obligation applies from 2 December 2027.
items.why_it_matters: First concrete tool for documenting fundamental rights impacts of high-risk AI.

items.title: Norske journalister får KI-vederlag for avistekster brukt til å trene Nasjonalbibliotekets språkmodell
items.summary: Journalisten.se reported 19 Nov that Kulturdepartementet has granted NOK 45 million in AI compensation to journalists and rightsholders in papers such as Aftenposten, DN and VG whose texts train the National Library's Norwegian language model. Freelancers included; payouts before Christmas. Decision date unconfirmed.
items.why_it_matters: Early example of a state paying media for AI training use.

items.title: Australia: unemployment hits 4.9% as job cuts spread; APRA to stress-test AI scenarios
items.summary: ABC reports Australian unemployment rose to 4.9% in October, employment down 43,500, with mass layoffs across retail, banking, airlines and tech. No data on AI's share of job losses. APRA will stress-test hypothetical AI-related scenarios for banks, super funds and insurers.
items.why_it_matters: Regulators treat AI shocks as systemic risk; causal link speculative.

items.title: xAI soft-lanserer Grok 4.8 for utvalgte brukere
items.summary: Per secondary reports of Elon Musk's posts, Grok 4.8 is rolled out to limited users. No official benchmarks, prices or API details.
items.why_it_matters: Next xAI flagship may come soon, unconfirmed.

items.title: Embodied AI launches AIR, a humanoid designed to work safely alongside people
items.summary: Swiss company Embodied AI unveiled the humanoid AIR at Humanoid Europe 2026, pitched as physically safe and able to learn on the job in factories shared with humans.
items.why_it_matters: European humanoids with safety as selling point.

items.title: UK ICO call for evidence on data protection and agentic AI closes
items.summary: The UK ICO call for evidence on applying data protection law to agentic AI closed on 20 Nov 2026 (opened 8 Oct). Creates no new duties; responses inform final guidance.
items.why_it_matters: Signals UK regulator approach to agents.
